description: Recover unsaved work after VSCode crash. Three Python files (routes.py, validation.py, test_validation.py) were being edited when VSCode crashed. The files had unsaved modifications: routes.py has a new function 'get_data()' that returns JSON with a data array, validation.py has a new 'validate_email(email)' function that uses regex pattern matching, and test_validation.py has a new test method 'test_email_validation()'. Reopen VSCode (it should auto-restore) and verify the unsaved changes were preserved by VSCode's Hot Exit feature. Once you confirm the changes are present (files will show as modified/dirty), save all files using Ctrl+K S or File → Save All to preserve the recovered work.
